blocks.text: IPOH, Malaysia – Four people, including a baby girl, were killed while a boy was injured in a crash involving a lorry and two cars along the East-West Highway near Gerik in Malaysia. The victims comprised two men, a woman and a baby girl. Gerik Fire and Rescue Station chief Mohd Rais Mahmud said the accident occurred along the highway from the Kelantan direction towards Gerik on Oct 4.
